additions.name: NSW RFS Major Fire Incidents Feed
additions.description: NSW Rural Fire Service live GeoJSON feed of current major bushfire and grassfire incidents with status and alert level.
additions.notes: No auth required; updated continuously by RFS. Landing page https://www.rfs.nsw.gov.au/fire-information/fires-near-me links to the feed.

additions.name: Victoria Emergency Incidents (FFM ArcGIS FeatureServer)
additions.description: Victorian government ArcGIS REST FeatureServer aggregating live CFA, FRV, SES and hazmat incidents including bushfires and floods.
additions.notes: Aggregates all incident types, not bushfire-only; query the FeatureServer layers for filtered results. Human-facing map at emergency.vic.gov.au.

additions.name: QFES Bushfire Current Incidents Feed
additions.description: Queensland Fire and Emergency Services JSON feed of current bushfire alerts and incident status across Queensland.
additions.notes: Public JSON endpoint underlying the QFES current-incidents map; no key required.

additions.name: SA CFS Current Incidents Feed
additions.description: South Australian Country Fire Service current incidents dataset published as JSON, RSS and CAP feeds via the SA open data portal.
additions.notes: Licence is non-commercial, no-derivatives (CC BY-NC-ND) - more restrictive than most AU emergency feeds; dataset metadata page shows a stale 'last updated' date though the underlying feed is understood to remain live.

additions.name: WA Emergency (DFES) Incident Map
additions.description: Western Australia DFES public incident map showing current bushfire, flood and other emergency warnings statewide.
additions.notes: The underlying DFES-066 incident dataset on data.wa.gov.au requires a free SLIP account plus an Esri access token (annual renewal) for programmatic access; this public map needs no login.

additions.name: Tasmania Fire Service Current Incidents Dataset
additions.description: Tasmania Fire Service current bushfire incidents published on data.gov.au in KML, RSS, GeoJSON and WMS/WFS formats.
additions.notes: Multiple format options listed on the dataset resource page; WMS/WFS endpoints suit GIS integration.

additions.name: NT PFES Fire Incident Map
additions.description: Northern Territory Police, Fire and Emergency Services near-real-time (10-15 min refresh) map of fire and emergency incidents.
additions.notes: Google Maps-based portal, not a raw machine-readable feed; symbols represent general incident area only.

additions.name: ACT ESA Current Incidents (GeoRSS)
additions.description: ACT Emergency Services Agency current-incidents GeoRSS feed sourced directly from the Computer Aided Dispatch system, updated every 60 seconds.
additions.notes: Coordinates in this feed are ordered [lat, lng], the reverse of standard GeoJSON ordering; feed link is published from the Warnings & Alerts page.

additions.name: Digital Earth Australia Hotspots
additions.description: Geoscience Australia satellite-derived (MODIS/VIIRS/AHI) thermal hotspot detections for bushfire monitoring across Australia, updated continuously.
additions.notes: A higher-cadence 'secure' tier with extra sensors is registration-restricted to emergency/government agencies; the public tier is open.

additions.name: NAFI - North Australia and Rangelands Fire Information
additions.description: Satellite hotspot and fire-scar mapping tool covering northern and central Australia's rangelands, widely used for savanna burning monitoring.
additions.notes: Some advanced layers/downloads require free account registration; basic hotspot map viewable without login.

additions.name: AFAC - Australasian Fire and Emergency Service Authorities Council
additions.description: National peak body coordinating Australian and NZ fire/emergency agencies; publishes situational awareness resources and links to state warning systems.
additions.notes: Directory/coordination body rather than a data feed; useful starting point for locating individual state agency resources.

additions.name: BOM Water Data Online
additions.description: Bureau of Meteorology portal for current and historical streamflow, storage level, rainfall and water-quality time series from ~6000 stations nationally.
additions.notes: Not a real-time flood feed; data supplied daily by state lead water agencies and mixes validated/provisional quality flags.

additions.name: BOM Flood Warnings
additions.description: Bureau of Meteorology national flood warning summary page linking to current flood watches, warnings and river-height bulletins per state.
additions.notes: Each state/river-basin bulletin also has a dedicated FTP text-bulletin feed; a modernised 5-minute flood data service for registered users is expected from BOM in late 2026.

additions.name: Australian Flood Risk Information Portal (AFRIP)
additions.description: Geoscience Australia portal cataloguing over 1500 flood studies and flood maps contributed nationally, snapshot current to 2018.
additions.notes: Data snapshot only covers flood studies completed up to 2018; ownership/reuse terms vary per contributing organisation.

additions.name: GA Flood Study Summary Web Services (WMS/WFS)
additions.description: OGC WMS and WFS endpoints serving Geoscience Australia's flood study and inundation map layers from the Australian Flood Studies Database.
additions.notes: eCat metadata record lists the specific WMS 1.3.0 and WFS service URLs; usage constraints are documented per individual flood study report.

additions.name: Geoscience Australia Earthquakes
additions.description: Geoscience Australia national earthquake monitoring service with near-real-time event map, magnitude/location details and notification feed.
additions.notes: Notification/feed URLs are documented on the site's Help page; the interactive map itself is at earthquakes.ga.gov.au.

additions.name: BOM Weather Warnings
additions.description: Bureau of Meteorology national summary of current severe weather, flood, fire weather, marine and tsunami warnings by state.
additions.notes: Underlying CAP/GIS2Web WMS-WFS services exist for warning polygons; commercial redistribution licensing terms are not fully clarified so treat as view-only unless BOM's data licence is separately confirmed.

additions.name: SILO Climate Data API
additions.description: Queensland Government API serving Australian point climate data (rainfall, temperature and more) from 1889 to yesterday, in CSV/JSON.
additions.notes: Requires a free API key obtained from the SILO website; national coverage with interpolated gridded infills, not just Queensland.

additions.name: ACORN-SAT Long-Term Temperature Record
additions.description: Bureau of Meteorology homogenised daily maximum/minimum temperature dataset from 112 long-record Australian stations, dating to 1910.
additions.notes: Bulk zipped CSV files also available via anonymous FTP at ftp://ftp.bom.gov.au/anon/home/ncc/www/change/ACORN_SAT_daily/.

additions.name: Joint Australian Tsunami Warning Centre
additions.description: Joint BOM/Geoscience Australia tsunami warning centre publishing current tsunami threat bulletins and warning zone maps for Australia.
additions.notes: JATWC bulletins are also distributed via BOM's public FTP and CAP feeds.

additions.name: Digital Atlas of Australia
additions.description: National spatial-data viewer covering geography, environment, infrastructure and demographic layers, launched as NationalMap's successor.
additions.notes: NationalMap was decommissioned 27 June 2025; the Digital Atlas of Australia is its designated replacement platform.

additions.name: ELVIS - Elevation and Depth - Foundation Spatial Data
additions.description: National elevation, LiDAR and bathymetry data discovery and download portal coordinated across Australian jurisdictions.
additions.notes: Coverage and resolution vary by contributing state/territory dataset.

additions.name: Digital Earth Australia Open Data on AWS
additions.description: Analysis-ready Sentinel-2 and Landsat satellite imagery for Australia hosted as a public AWS Open Data bucket, freely downloadable.
additions.notes: Requester-pays not applicable; data is fully open on S3, suited for bulk/cloud analysis workflows.

additions.name: NSW SIX Maps
additions.description: NSW Spatial Services interactive map viewer for cadastre, imagery, topography and property information across New South Wales.
additions.notes: Requires WebGL2-capable browser; underlying data also available via NSW Spatial Services web services.

additions.name: Vicmap / Land Victoria Spatial Data
additions.description: Victorian government authoritative spatial data catalogue (Vicmap) and interactive mapping tools including the LASSI platform.
additions.notes: Some premium Vicmap products (e.g. high-res property data) may require a data licence agreement.

additions.name: Queensland Globe
additions.description: Queensland Government's 3D web-based mapping application for imagery, cadastre, hazards and planning layers statewide.
additions.notes: Built on a Cesium/WebGL viewer; layer data also exposed via Queensland Spatial Catalogue WMS/WFS services.

additions.name: Landgate Map Viewer Plus (WA)
additions.description: Western Australia's official land information authority portal for cadastre, aerial imagery and property data via Map Viewer Plus.
additions.notes: Basic viewing is free; purchasing aerial imagery or certain title/property products incurs a fee.

additions.name: SA Location Map Viewer
additions.description: South Australian Government spatial data viewer for cadastre, imagery and topographic layers across the state.
additions.notes: Companion data catalogue and WMS/WFS services available via the same location.sa.gov.au domain.

additions.name: LISTmap - Land Information System Tasmania
additions.description: Tasmania's official land information portal providing cadastre, aerial photography, heritage and open spatial data web services.
additions.notes: Also hosts Tasmania's open spatial data catalogue and web map/feature services.

additions.name: Geoscape G-NAF (Geocoded National Address File)
additions.description: Australia's authoritative geocoded address database, distilling over 50 million contributed addresses into ~16 million validated physical addresses.
additions.notes: Large multi-table dataset (~1.5 GB zipped per datum, ~5 GB unpacked) requiring joins prior to use; subject to an End User Licence Agreement.

additions.name: data.gov.au - Australian Government Open Data Portal
additions.description: National open data catalogue aggregating thousands of federal, state and local government datasets across all sectors.
additions.notes: Individual datasets carry their own licence; most emergency/geo datasets referenced elsewhere in this file are hosted here.

additions.name: ABS Data API
additions.description: Australian Bureau of Statistics SDMX-based REST API for querying census, economic and demographic statistical datasets programmatically.
additions.notes: SDMX-JSON/XML query interface; no key required for public series.

additions.name: ABN Lookup / Australian Business Register Web Services
additions.description: Australian Business Register API for querying ABN registration status, business name and GST details for any registered entity.
additions.notes: Requires a free GUID registration for SOAP/REST access; bulk ABN extract also downloadable from data.gov.au.

additions.name: ASIC Search Our Registers
additions.description: Australian Securities and Investments Commission's public register search for companies, business names, professionals and disqualified persons.
additions.notes: Basic name searches are free; detailed company extracts/documents incur a per-record fee.

additions.name: AusTender
additions.description: Australian Government's central publication point for procurement notices, awarded contracts and business opportunities.
additions.notes: Bulk contract notice data also republished on data.gov.au for offline analysis.

additions.name: AEC Transparency Register
additions.description: Australian Electoral Commission register of political donations, annual and election financial disclosure returns, downloadable in bulk.
additions.notes: Bulk ZIP/CSV downloads cover annual, election and referendum disclosure data from 1998-99 onward.

additions.name: Parliament of Australia Hansard
additions.description: Official verbatim transcripts of federal House of Representatives and Senate parliamentary debates, searchable and downloadable.
additions.notes: Historical Hansard archives and XML transcripts also available for bulk research use.

additions.name: Federal Court of Australia Daily Court Lists
additions.description: Daily published listing of Federal Court of Australia hearings, case numbers, parties and courtrooms nationwide.
additions.notes: Individual state Supreme/District/Magistrates courts publish separate daily lists on their own websites.

additions.name: AEMO NEM Data Dashboard
additions.description: Australian Energy Market Operator's live and historical wholesale electricity market data for the National Electricity Market.
additions.notes: Covers NEM-connected states only (not WA/NT, which run separate markets); 5-minute dispatch data and generator output are publicly downloadable.

additions.name: Transport for NSW Open Data (GTFS-Realtime)
additions.description: NSW Government transport open data hub providing GTFS and GTFS-Realtime feeds for trains, buses, ferries and light rail.
additions.notes: Requires a free API key/application registration for feed access.

additions.name: PTV Timetable API (Victoria)
additions.description: Public Transport Victoria's developer API for timetable, disruption and real-time journey planning data across Melbourne and regional Victoria.
additions.notes: Requires a free developer ID and signed request key issued by PTV.

additions.name: Airservices Australia Aviation Data
additions.description: Australia's air navigation service provider, publishing aviation weather, NOTAM and aircraft noise/flight path data.
additions.notes: Some aviation weather/NOTAM products require a NAIPS account; noise/flight-path data is separately published via WebTrak.

additions.name: NSW Air Quality Data Download
additions.description: NSW Department of Planning and Environment air quality monitoring network data, with hourly pollutant and particulate readings statewide.
additions.notes: Other states (VIC EPA, QLD DES) publish equivalent but separately-hosted air quality datasets.

additions.name: NBN Co Network Outages
additions.description: National Broadband Network operator's public page for checking current and planned network outages by location.
additions.notes: Address-level lookup only, not a bulk feed; individual retail ISPs (Telstra, Optus) run their own separate outage-status pages.
